Total Solar Eclipse Observed Across Parts of Europe

A total solar eclipse occurred on Wednesday, plunging parts of Spain into darkness. Crowds in London witnessed a partial eclipse with over 90% coverage. Skywatchers across Europe gathered to observe the rare celestial event. Scientists also used the eclipse to study the sun's corona. Some observers in Spain were in Mallorca, while others viewed it from flights.
